notes: Key ask: predictable p99 tail latency <= 250ms for chat (max prompt 1k tokens) and sustained 2k concurrent QPS for embeddings/rerank workload.
Workload mix: 55% chat (context windows up to 3k tokens occasionally), 30% embedding vectorization (batchable), 15% reranking (low latency, high QPS).
Model preference: open quantized Llama-3/70B variant for cost control; fallback to 13B/30B hosted variants for spikes and maintenance windows.
Acceptable cost target: unit token cost < 0.7x current self-hosted baseline after batching + KV cache optimizations; finance is sensitive to committed spend.
Security: must support customer-managed KMS and SAML SSO; audit logs retained 90 days and delivered to SIEM via secure sink; data residency in us-east required.
POC sizing request: initial reserved pool = 8x A100-80GB equivalent (estimate), with burst headroom to 12 instances for traffic surges during soak tests.
Routing policy ask: region pinning + weight-based fallback to cheaper quantized variant when queue depth > 50 to protect p99 SLOs.
AE quote from 3/2 call: "If Dedicated can hit sustained p99 in target envelope for 72 hours we can get a 12-month commit approved by finance."
SE notes: enable prefix KV caching for chat flows and 4096 token KV chunking; proposed batch sizes: embeddings 128, rerank mini-batches 32, chat autoregressive batching dynamic up to 16.
Security team pushed back on network egress; need explicit VPC peering diagram and egress IP allowlist before production sign-off.
